source_review_findings.resolution: Parent added request_stop independent of measurement ticks; sticky stop survives recovery.

source_review_findings.observed_in: source review before new test execution
source_review_findings.problem: project_native_snapshot inferred legacy195kg identity from a generic snapshot with only syntactically valid opaque hashes.
source_review_findings.resolution: Explicit model_id declaration now required, with model_lineage_verified:false and caller_declared_not_verified labeling. No claim of actual lineage authentication.

source_review_findings.problem: round can place raw fraction0.40049 at per-mille400 or0.59951 at600. This is explicit quantization rather than continuous physiological threshold enforcement.
source_review_findings.resolution: Coordinator now uses ceil for pressure/fatigue and floor for energy; conservative integer projection avoids early resume from round-to-nearest.

source_review_findings.problem: Initial implementation_sha256 map omitted coordinator itself.
source_review_findings.resolution: Coordinator includes its own source SHA256 in implementation_sha256 alongside the invoked component modules.

source_review_findings.problem: Python -I alone does not disable all system-site initialization, so blanket sitecustomization isolation wording was too broad.
source_review_findings.resolution: Both native_readout and state_models use -I -S. Actual probes with poisoned parent sys.modules and PYTHONPATH passed.

source_review_findings.observed_in: runtime extension source review before disposable probe
source_review_findings.problem: Initial hidden --worker path could call prepare_defaults in a caller-selected verified source directory. Existing generated defaults were not part of pinned-source comparison and could be overwritten.
source_review_findings.resolution: Final worker itself verifies and copies only the45pinned files into a new temporary directory before observation. Both normal public calls and direct hidden-worker calls leave caller defaults and extra files untouched. Retained regression now verifies successful isolated readout with original synthetic canary preserved. No actual overwrite was observed.

actual_runs.error_reason: Default source root lacked IMPORT_PROVENANCE.json in sparse checkout; native source preflight stopped before subprocess execution.

unresolved_limits: Authored software fixtures and rule compliance do not show physiological, subjective or task-performance benefit.
Caller exports and clocks are declared inputs, not authenticated sensors or issuer attestations.
Receipt freshness is report age, never proof of active worker or current operation.
Native195kg, visual78kg and MuJoCo78kg remain separate model lineages.
Catalogue coverage does not mean neural, affect, genome, visual or ritual runtime wiring.
Checksum consistency is not protection against coordinated data-and-checksum replacement.
No external executor or trusted authorization verifier exists.
This bounded review is not a complete security audit or independent human validation.
Fresh initial simulation readout is not a live or saved user body state; no physiological progression was executed.
Local neural steps and affect transition execute authored toy models; they are not underlying LLM internals or subjective feelings.
Native tests assert same-run before/after state equality, not cross-process bit identity of opaque checkpoint hashes.
Subprocess isolated mode is process/import isolation, not a malicious-code security sandbox; pinned source review remains necessary.
